verdict: M2058 is conclusively a consumed failed attempt and may never be retried or cited for power/energy. Its sole license preflight, ordinary-LRU4 compile, and ordinary-LRU4 simv occurred; no SAIF, PTPX, TSBG compile, or TSBG sim occurred. The mapped simulation completed the exact 383-cycle preload, then failed 10 ps after full_execute_begin and before the first UCLI stop because one or more members of the 21-field bridge/commit/control check were X/Z. The preceding load/reset and memory-handshake checks passed. Exact member localization is impossible from this artifact because the fatal coalesces all 21 fields and no per-signal dump or waveform exists. Static source/netlist tracing rules out the ascending-unpacked bank/lane flatten reversal as the direct cause of this particular check; the strongest supported classification is mapped invalid-sideband/initial-state observability at the pre-execute boundary, with an internal M803 control contribution not fully excludable. This is not evidence of an arithmetic or workload failure, but mapped dynamic equivalence remains unproven. A separately named successor may be authored using settled sampling and valid-gated sideband checks, then receive a fresh source hammer and at most one new no-retry attempt. No execution is authorized by this review.

adapter_unpacked_flatten_order.reason: The failed check precedes the later unpacked bank metadata/payload checks. Scalar controls are named direct connections, and bridge_bank_valid is a native packed [7:0] direct connection. Static high-segment element-zero flatten evidence remains intact.

external_m803_adapter.reason: Only protocol_error, stale_response_seen and busy in the failed group depend on M803 internal control. Its state is explicitly reset in RTL, but the grouped fatal does not reveal whether these were the unknown members.

mapped_netlist_invalid_sideband_or_initi.reason: The failure is confined to the mapped ordinary axis at the pre-execute boundary, before request/product service; the exact source RTL passes slot42 in M2057. Many checked sidebands are semantically invalid while their valid qualifier is low, yet M2056 checks them unconditionally. Mapped dynamic equivalence was explicitly absent from the M2056 source admission.

sampling_transient.reason: The initial endpoint check already occurs at the descriptor-load negedge plus 10 ps, 1.51 ns after the preceding posedge. The TSMC cell Verilog contains no UNIT_DELAY conditional and uses zero specify delays; no SDF is annotated. The compile-time UNIT_DELAY define is therefore inert for this run.

real_arithmetic_or_workload_function.reason: No useful mapped request, bridge issue, product, commit, or SAIF window occurred. M2057 source-RTL slot42 independently passes the exact 149-row/1278-issue/29472-product ledger. This does not prove mapped netlist equivalence.

p1_findings: P1-1: The 21-field grouped fatal and absence of waveform/per-signal print make exact unknown-member localization unrecoverable. A future harness must print or separately assert every unconditional qualifier/control and each valid-gated sideband group.

P1-2: The declared failure quarantine was not published or sealed. VCS generated two symlinks, seal_dir rejected them, and the nested publication exception was swallowed. The hidden stage is pinned only by this review's complete tree fingerprint and key-file hashes.
P1-3: +define+UNIT_DELAY is not consumed by the TSMC cell model and no SDF was annotated. This artifact must be called zero-delay mapped functional simulation, not unit-delay gate simulation.
p2_findings: P2-1: A successor's valid gating must apply only to payload/sideband fields. Valid, ready, accept, protocol_error, stale_response_seen, numeric_overflow, busy, reset, clock, and all measured work counters remain unconditionally known and checked. No execute cycle may be silently removed from the energy denominator.

Emit separate signal/group diagnostics so an X/Z cannot collapse into another 21-field ambiguity.
Preserve global slot42, exact mapped netlists, ports, 383-cycle preload, 20292/7569 execute denominators, UCLI hierarchy and final M2051 PASS.
Keep SAIF TX=0, complete annotation and power subtotal gates; valid gating may not excuse an X transition recorded in the measured mapped scope.
